data.title: Napoli confirm injuries to Badiashile and Spinazzola but get one defender back - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
Advertisement

It has been a frustrating day for Napoli, who have recently learned that head coach Massimiliano Allegri will be suspended for the next two games, and are now preparing to go into Wednesday's Serie A match against Monza without Benoit Badiashile or Leonardo Spinazzola, who are both injured.

## Napoli confirm injuries to Badiashile and Spinazzola, Rrahmani back [...] NAPLES, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 13: Leonardo Spinazzola during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and Bologna FC at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on September 13, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images)

data.title: Opposition insight for Udinese-Milan: Form, injuries, predicted XI and more
data.content:
They did manage a draw against the hyped Como at the start of the season, but their win came against another struggling side, namely Monza. In short, something clearly isn’t clicking and Udinese have confirmed that Runjaic now has three games to prove his worth. Talk about pressure. [...] ➤ Manager: Kosta Runjaic  
 ➤ Form (all comps):L-L-L-L-L (most recent)  
 ➤ Top scorer (Serie A): Ekkelenkamp – 3  
 ➤ Most assists (Serie A): Davis – 2  
 ➤ Injuries & suspensions: Alaba, Bayo, Gueye, Zanoli.

It’s been a rough start to the season for Udinese and that’s putting it mildly. They were a force to be reckoned with in the 2025-26 campaign, finishing in 10th with 50 points (beating Milan too), but they haven’t been able to replicate that so far. [...] Two changes are expected in defence, with James Abankwah and Matteo Palma coming in, while Jakub Piotrowski looks set to replace Oier Zarraga in midfield. Other than that, it will be the expected Udinese with key players like Omar Solet, Jesper Karlström, Jurgen Ekkelenkamp and Kenan Davies.

Oumar Solet is in the predicted eleven right now, but Runjaic did warn that he might not make it due to a muscle problem.
